posts.title: Another Sleeping Giant Awakens
posts.description: There’s no stock market. No internet. No e-mail. And despite a wealth of natural resources, from rice to gold to hydrocarbons, it’s one of the poorest countries in the world. Still, I think there's a great a way to invest in the future of Myanmar: Go there.
